name: AO SMITH Z1
summary: A.O. Smith Z1 UV+UF Water Purifier is a premium UV+UF purifier designed for municipal water with TDS up to 200 ppm.
intro: The A.O. Smith Z1 UV+UF Water Purifier is a premium hot and normal water purifier designed for municipal water supplies with TDS below 200 ppm. Featuring advanced 5-stage UV + UF (Ultra Fine) purification, it delivers safe, healthy drinking water while preserving essential minerals. With 45°C warm water, 80°C hot water, a 9.2 L storage tank, digital display, and night assist feature, the Z1 combines convenience, performance, and elegant design for modern kitchens.
